label: Bible Study
prompt: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the _____ of all thine increase:
verse: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
note: Honour from the top of the harvest, not the leftovers — just a few verses after 'Trust in the LORD.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to _____.
verse: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
note: Joshua's report card for God: not one good thing He promised failed — all came to pass.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by _____ land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verse: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
note: The Red Sea crossing in one line: Israel walked through on dry land; the Egyptians tried it and drowned.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I have set _____ upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
verse: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
note: Isaiah posts watchmen on Jerusalem's walls who are told never to stop reminding God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a _____ place, and there prayed.
verse: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
note: After a long evening of healing in Capernaum, Jesus rose 'a great while before day' to pray alone.
